lot_size_in_base.meaning: lotSizeInBase market lot constraint in base asset wei

fok_buy_amount.meaning: FOK order buy size submitted via postFillOrder in base asset wei

order_amount_after_match.meaning: newOrder.amount remaining after matching engine fills the tradeable portion

tradeable_filled.meaning: the full tradeable portion of the FOK order was filled by the matching engine

dust_remainder.meaning: remaining unfilled amount is strictly below lotSizeInBase and thus untradeable

assumptions: postFillOrder is callable by the FOK taker for this market.
The matching engine fills the tradeable portion before the completeness check runs.
A remaining amount below lotSizeInBase cannot be matched further in this market.

unresolved.description: Report does not define the exact dust-remainder numeric expression; the untradeable sub-lot remainder is represented by the report-stated boolean dust_remainder rather than an invented numeric remainder.
Report does not specify whether the taker is authorized/whitelisted or whether anyone may call postFillOrder.

limitations: Second extracted impact i_fok_unreliable is deferred to a future claim.
The scenario may be hypothetical; this plan formalizes the report relation, not an executed transaction.
Actual source lines for the completeness check are not supplied, so code-level binding is deferred.
The check newOrder.amount > 0 is represented by the report-grounded relation over tradeable_filled and dust_remainder without inventing the exact remainder constant.
